integrity: The result is derived directly from the published model equations by exact period integration and algebraic subtraction. The included checker verifies the algebraic identities with exact rational arithmetic. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to strictly positive periodic solutions and positive equilibria of the coefficient-averaged SIRI system. It proves exact balance identities, not existence or uniqueness of the periodic orbit, not a universal sign of prevalence bias, and not global validity of averaging.
title: An exact covariance decomposition for seasonal prevalence bias
